functions.name: iter
functions.done: Builds an iterator over a vector, matrix, data frame, function, or an existing iterator.

check.case: iter on a vector, checkFunc, recycle, list, empty input, matrix, data frame, and function

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(iterators))

num <- function(x) {
  if (is.matrix(x)) x <- as.vector(x)
  if (is.data.frame(x)) x <- as.numeric(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))
  if (is.list(x)) x <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
  paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = ",")
}

err <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch({
    force(expr)
    "OK"
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}

one <- function() {
  it <- iter(c(1, 2, 3))
  v <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it))
  e <- err(nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(1:6, checkFunc = function(i) i %% 2 == 0)
  ev <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(c(10, 20), recycle = TRUE)
  rc <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(c(1.5, 2.5))
  db <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(list(4, c(8, 9)))
  l1 <- nextElem(it)
  l2 <- nextElem(it)

  it <- iter(integer(0))
  empty <- err(nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(1:3, checkFunc = function(i) i < 0)
  none <- err(nextElem(it))

  m <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2)
  it <- iter(m, by = "column", chunksize = 2)
  ch1 <- nextElem(it)
  ch2 <- nextElem(it)
  ch.end <- err(nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(m, by = "cell")
  cells <- sapply(1:6, function(k) nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(m, by = "row")
  row1 <- nextElem(it)

  it <- iter(m, "ce")
  cell1 <- nextElem(it)

  it <- iter(m, by = "column", recycle = TRUE)
  mr <- c(
    as.vector(nextElem(it)), as.vector(nextElem(it)),
    as.vector(nextElem(it)), as.vector(nextElem(it))
  )

  x <- matrix(1:10, ncol = 2)
  it <- iter(x, by = "column", checkFunc = function(i) i[5] %% 10 == 0)
  kept <- nextElem(it)

  w <- ""
  it <- withCallingHandlers(
    iter(m, by = "cell", chunksize = 2),
    warning = function(w0) {
      w <<- conditionMessage(w0)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  wcell <- nextElem(it)
  wtext <- gsub("\n", " / ", w, fixed = TRUE)

  bad <- err(iter(m, by = "c"))
  bad.df <- err(iter(data.frame(a = 1:2), by = "cell"))

  df <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(10, 20, 30))
  it <- iter(df)
  cx <- nextElem(it)
  cy <- nextElem(it)
  it <- iter(df, by = "row")
  r1 <- nextElem(it)
  r2 <- nextElem(it)
  it <- iter(df, by = "row", recycle = TRUE)
  for (k in 1:3) nextElem(it)
  rwrap <- nextElem(it)

  it <- iter(data.frame(z = c("a", "b", "c")))
  letters <- paste(nextElem(it), collapse = ",")

  it <- iter(data.frame(x = 1:4), by = "row", checkFunc = function(i) i[[1]][1] %% 2 == 0)
  evrow <- c(as.numeric(unlist(nextElem(it))), as.numeric(unlist(nextElem(it))))

  it <- iter(data.frame(x = c(5, 6)), "row")
  pos <- as.numeric(unlist(nextElem(it)))

  it <- iter(function(i) i * 10)
  f <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it))
  it <- iter(function() 7)
  f0 <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(function(i) if (i > 2) stop("StopIteration") else i, recycle = TRUE)
  fr <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it))

  it <- iter(function(i) if (i > 2) stop("too high") else i)
  fh <- c(nextElem(it), nextElem(it))
  fherr <- err(nextElem(it))

  base <- iter(c(9, 8))
  same <- if (identical(base, iter(base))) "SAME" else "DIFF"
  same.v <- c(nextElem(base), nextElem(base))

  paste(c(
    num(v), e, num(ev), num(rc), num(db), num(l1), num(l2), empty, none,
    num(ch1), num(ch2), ch.end, num(cells), num(row1), num(cell1), num(mr), num(kept),
    wtext, num(wcell), bad, bad.df,
    num(cx), num(cy), num(r1), num(r2), num(rwrap), letters, num(evrow), num(pos),
    num(f), num(f0), num(fr), num(fh), fherr, same, num(same.v)
  ), collapse = "|")
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat("VALUE ", value, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))

import statistics
import sys
import time
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from iterators.core import DataFrame, IteratorError, iter, nextElem


def num(value):
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        values = np.ravel(value, order="F")
        return ",".join(format(item, ".17g") for item in values)
    if isinstance(value, DataFrame):
        flat = []
        for name in value.names:
            flat.extend(value.columns[name])
        return ",".join(format(item, ".17g") for item in flat)
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return ",".join(format(item, ".17g") for item in value)
    return format(value, ".17g")


def err(fn):
    try:
        fn()
        return "OK"
    except IteratorError as exc:
        return exc.message


def one():
    it = iter([1, 2, 3])
    v = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    e = err(lambda: nextElem(it))

    it = iter(list(range(1, 7)), checkFunc=lambda i: i % 2 == 0)
    ev = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]

    it = iter([10, 20], recycle=True)
    rc = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]

    it = iter([1.5, 2.5])
    db = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]

    it = iter([4, [8, 9]])
    l1 = nextElem(it)
    l2 = nextElem(it)

    it = iter([])
    empty = err(lambda: nextElem(it))

    it = iter([1, 2, 3], checkFunc=lambda i: i < 0)
    none = err(lambda: nextElem(it))

    m = np.arange(1, 7).reshape((2, 3), order="F")
    it = iter(m, by="column", chunksize=2)
    ch1 = nextElem(it)
    ch2 = nextElem(it)
    ch_end = err(lambda: nextElem(it))

    it = iter(m, by="cell")
    cells = [nextElem(it) for _ in range(6)]

    it = iter(m, by="row")
    row1 = nextElem(it)

    it = iter(m, "ce")
    cell1 = nextElem(it)

    it = iter(m, by="column", recycle=True)
    mr = []
    for _ in range(4):
        mr.extend(np.ravel(nextElem(it), order="F").tolist())

    x = np.arange(1, 11).reshape((5, 2), order="F")

    def keep_tenth(chunk):
        return int(np.ravel(chunk, order="F")[4]) % 10 == 0

    it = iter(x, by="column", checkFunc=keep_tenth)
    kept = nextElem(it)

    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        it = iter(m, by="cell", chunksize=2)
    wtext = "" if not caught else str(caught[0].message).replace("\n", " / ")
    wcell = nextElem(it)

    bad = err(lambda: iter(m, by="c"))
    bad_df = err(lambda: iter(DataFrame({"a": [1, 2]}), by="cell"))

    df = DataFrame({"x": [1, 2, 3], "y": [10, 20, 30]})
    it = iter(df)
    cx = nextElem(it)
    cy = nextElem(it)
    it = iter(df, by="row")
    r1 = nextElem(it)
    r2 = nextElem(it)
    it = iter(df, by="row", recycle=True)
    for _ in range(3):
        nextElem(it)
    rwrap = nextElem(it)

    it = iter(DataFrame({"z": ["a", "b", "c"]}))
    letters = ",".join(nextElem(it))

    def even_row(row):
        return row.columns["x"][0] % 2 == 0

    it = iter(DataFrame({"x": [1, 2, 3, 4]}), by="row", checkFunc=even_row)
    evrow = []
    evrow.extend(nextElem(it).columns["x"])
    evrow.extend(nextElem(it).columns["x"])

    it = iter(DataFrame({"x": [5, 6]}), "row")
    pos = nextElem(it).columns["x"]

    it = iter(lambda i: i * 10)
    f = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    it = iter(lambda: 7)
    f0 = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]

    def restart(i):
        if i > 2:
            raise IteratorError("StopIteration")
        return i

    it = iter(restart, recycle=True)
    fr = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]

    def too_high(i):
        if i > 2:
            raise IteratorError("too high")
        return i

    it = iter(too_high)
    fh = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    fherr = err(lambda: nextElem(it))

    base = iter([9, 8])
    same = "SAME" if iter(base) is base else "DIFF"
    same_v = [nextElem(base), nextElem(base)]

    parts = [
        num(v), e, num(ev), num(rc), num(db), num(l1), num(l2), empty, none,
        num(ch1), num(ch2), ch_end, num(cells), num(row1), num(cell1), num(mr), num(kept),
        wtext, num(wcell), bad, bad_df,
        num(cx), num(cy), num(r1), num(r2), num(rwrap), letters, num(evrow), num(pos),
        num(f), num(f0), num(fr), num(fh), fherr, same, num(same_v),
    ]
    return "|".join(parts)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("VALUE " + value)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from iterators.core import IteratorError, icount, iter, nextElem


def flat(value):
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return [format(item, ".17g") for item in np.ravel(value, order="F")]
    return [format(value, ".17g")]


def one():
    it = iter(["a", "b", "c"])
    ch = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    try:
        nextElem(it)
        e = "OK"
    except IteratorError as exc:
        e = exc.message
    it = iter([4, 5, 6])
    n = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    it = icount(2)
    k = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    try:
        nextElem(it)
        ek = "OK"
    except IteratorError as exc:
        ek = exc.message
    m = np.arange(1, 7).reshape((2, 3), order="F")
    it = iter(m, by="column", chunksize=2)
    p1 = flat(nextElem(it))
    p2 = flat(nextElem(it))
    it = iter(lambda i: i * 10)
    f = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    it = iter([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], checkFunc=lambda i: i != 3)
    sk = [nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it), nextElem(it)]
    parts = [
        *ch, e,
        *[format(v, ".17g") for v in n],
        *[format(v, ".17g") for v in k], ek,
        *p1, *p2,
        *[format(v, ".17g") for v in f],
        *[format(v, ".17g") for v in sk],
    ]
    return "|".join(parts)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("VALUE " + value)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(iterators))
stopifnot(packageVersion("iterators") == "1.0.14")

fmt_num <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return("EMPTY")
  paste(vapply(seq_along(x), function(i) {
    v <- x[[i]]
    if (is.nan(v)) "NaN"
    else if (is.na(v)) "NA"
    else if (is.infinite(v)) {
      if (v > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf"
    } else sprintf("%.17g", v)
  }, ""), collapse = ",")
}

step <- function(it) {
  w <- character()
  v <- withCallingHandlers(
    tryCatch(nextElem(it), error = function(e) structure(conditionMessage(e), class = "err")),
    warning = function(w0) {
      w <<- c(w, conditionMessage(w0))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  if (inherits(v, "err")) {
    text <- paste0("ERR:", gsub("\n", "<NL>", v, fixed = TRUE))
  } else {
    text <- paste0("NUM:", fmt_num(v))
  }
  if (length(w)) text <- paste0("W:", paste(w, collapse = ","), ";", text)
  text
}

build <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch({
    force(expr)
    "OK"
  }, error = function(e) paste0("ERR:", gsub("\n", "<NL>", conditionMessage(e), fixed = TRUE)))
}

one <- function() {
  parts <- character()
  add <- function(...) {
    parts <<- c(parts, as.character(unlist(list(...), recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)))
  }

  set.seed(1)
  it <- irunif(5)
  add(step(it), step(it))

  set.seed(1)
  it <- irunif(1, count = 3)
  add(step(it), step(it), step(it), step(it))

  set.seed(1)
  it <- irunif(1, min = 2, max = 5, count = 2)
  add(step(it), step(it), step(it))

  set.seed(1)
  add(step(irunif(2, min = c(0, 10), max = c(1, 11))))

  set.seed(1)
  add(step(irunif(3, min = c(0, 5, 0), max = 1)))

  set.seed(1)

  set.seed(1)

import math
import statistics
import sys
import time
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from iterators.core import IteratorError, iter, nextElem
from iterators.irunif import NA, irunif, set_seed


def fmt_num(values):
    if len(values) == 0:
        return "EMPTY"
    parts = []
    for value in values:
        if value is NA:
            parts.append("NA")
            continue
        number = float(value)
        if number == 0.0 and math.copysign(1.0, number) < 0:
            parts.append("-0")
            continue
        if math.isnan(number):
            parts.append("NaN")
        elif math.isinf(number):
            parts.append("Inf" if number > 0 else "-Inf")
        else:
            parts.append(format(number, ".17g"))
    return ",".join(parts)


def step(it):
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            value = nextElem(it)
            text = "NUM:" + fmt_num(value)
        except IteratorError as exc:
